[Satya Nadella](https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella?trk=public_post_comment-text) , the emergency brake has to reach the agents that never received the original human instruction. One agent assigns the work, another hands it off, and a third takes the action. That is where the chain I described in The Provenance Problem gets harder to defend. Withdrawing permission needs to travel through those handoffs, while the evidence of what already happened stays intact.

[Ripudaman Singh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hirirngdots?trk=public_post_comment_actor-name) 1mo


Why not just get people from the big SI companies together with researchers, ethicists, regular folks who’ll be affected, and anyone else who cares, so we can actually talk through a shared direction and some practical guidelines? We’ve already got a ton of solid ideas floating around from all kinds of people about how to do this responsibly. They’re just scattered all over the place. Give everyone a common place to put those ideas, including the wild warnings and the ones that sound a bit out there. Then we can look at them properly, try them out, and decide what to keep, what to drop, and what still needs more talking about, until the best parts rise to the top.


[Ryan Sweet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mryansweet?trk=public_post_comment_actor-name) 1mo


Wtf?[Satya Nadella](https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella?trk=public_post_comment-text) Why are you giving in to the coercion from the government to use NewSpeak and call it “Super Intelligence”? Forget “models as insider risks” - How are you going to measure and protect the company from the massive risk of appeasement, enablement, and facilitation of random and inane directives pushed on you through fiat, barely comprehensible pronouncements, and illegal pressure? It’s amazing that AI can make so many incredible things, but it seems to be unable to help any corporate leaders locate their backbone. Have you not noticed yet that no amount of kissing the ring will make this government behave within the bounds of predictable, coherent, and sustainable relationships with her most valuable corporations? It’s a random roller coaster ride and the more you do acts of voluntary compliance the harder they will keep pushing you. This may be a small thing, “super intelligence”, but it’s test, no doubt, and you failed and it we are all going to suffer as they keep ratcheting up the pressure in other ways. I’m so disappointed in someone whom I genuinely respect and admire.
